title: test_semantic_herb_search_with_valid_query_and_limit
description: Verify that POST /search with a valid non-empty query string and a numeric limit between 1 and 50 returns a 200 response with ranked herb results, each similarity >= 0.3, and the number of results does not exceed the limit. Results are re-ranked by Cohere: when every result has a numeric `relevance` (0-1), results are sorted by relevance descending (similarity order is not asserted); if `relevance` is absent (reranker fallback), results are sorted by similarity descending.

title: test_semantic_herb_search_with_missing_or_empty_query
description: Verify that POST /search with a missing or empty query string returns a 400 response with an error message indicating that the query is required and must be a string.

title: test_semantic_herb_search_with_invalid_limit
description: Verify that POST /search with a limit provided as a string or a number outside the range 1 to 50 returns a 400 response with an error message indicating that the limit must be a number between 1 and 50.

title: test_cors_preflight_on_search_endpoint
description: Verify that OPTIONS /search from an allowed Origin returns a 200 response with Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoing the Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Methods including POST.

title: test_nutritionist_post_with_valid_messages_streaming_response
description: Verify that POST /nutritionist where the user has already answered the nutritionist's diagnostic questions (send exactly this messages array: [{"role": "user", "content": "I can't sleep"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "That sounds exhausting. A few questions so I can point you the right way: is it trouble falling asleep or staying asleep? How long has it been going on? And are you taking any medications?"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Staying asleep, I wake at 3am with racing thoughts. About a month. No meds, not pregnant."}]) returns 200 with Content-Type text/event-stream. The first SSE event is 'stage' with data {"stage": "treatment"}; the stream then includes tool_use, herb_results (non-empty herbs array), text_delta and done, with tool_use before herb_results before done. Use a 120 s read timeout.

title: test_nutritionist_post_with_invalid_json_body
description: Verify that POST /nutritionist with an invalid JSON body returns a 400 response with {"error":"Invalid JSON body"}.

title: test_nutritionist_post_with_invalid_messages_array
description: Verify that POST /nutritionist with messages array exceeding 50 entries or last message not from user returns a 400 response with a validation error message.

title: test_nutritionist_vague_first_message_diagnoses_without_herb_cards
description: Verify that POST /nutritionist with messages [{"role": "user", "content": "I can't sleep"}] returns 200 with Content-Type text/event-stream. The first SSE event is 'stage' with data {"stage": "diagnostic"}; the stream contains at least one text_delta and ends with done, and contains NO herb_results event and NO tool_use event. The concatenated text_delta text contains a question mark. Use a 120 s read timeout.
